name: Economic profit
note: root metric (not scored)
equation: Non-financials: (ROIC - WACC) x average IC = NOPAT - WACC x average IC (defined even when IC <= 0); financials: (ROE - Ke) x average equity

name: Revenue CAGR 3y
note: window spans a merger or balance-sheet step change (FY24): growth largely inorganic, not scored

name: Revenue CAGR 5y
note: window spans a merger or balance-sheet step change (FY24): growth largely inorganic, not scored

name: Revenue CAGR (full span, up to 10y)
note: CAGR over 9 years (FY17-FY26); export holds 10 annual points
equation: (Revenue_t / Revenue_t-n)^(1/n) - 1, n = full available span <= 10; n/m if either value <= 0

name: PAT CAGR 3y
note: window spans a merger or balance-sheet step change (FY24): growth largely inorganic, not scored

name: PAT CAGR 5y
note: window spans a merger or balance-sheet step change (FY24): growth largely inorganic, not scored

name: PAT CAGR (full span, up to 10y)
note: CAGR over 9 years (FY17-FY26); export holds 10 annual points
equation: (PAT_t / PAT_t-n)^(1/n) - 1, n = full available span <= 10; n/m if either value <= 0

name: EPS CAGR 3y
note: window spans a merger or balance-sheet step change (FY24): growth largely inorganic, not scored

name: EPS CAGR 5y
note: window spans a merger or balance-sheet step change (FY24): growth largely inorganic, not scored

name: EPS CAGR (full span, up to 10y)
note: CAGR over 9 years (FY17-FY26); export holds 10 annual points
equation: (EPS_t / EPS_t-n)^(1/n) - 1, n = full available span <= 10; n/m if either value <= 0

name: Book value per share CAGR 5y
note: window spans a merger or balance-sheet step change (FY24): growth largely inorganic, not scored

name: Total assets CAGR 3y
note: window spans a merger or balance-sheet step change (FY24): growth largely inorganic, not scored

name: Net interest income CAGR 3y
note: window spans a merger or balance-sheet step change (FY24): growth largely inorganic, not scored
equation: (NII_t / NII_t-3)^(1/3) - 1, NII = interest earned - interest expended

name: Revenue growth volatility
equation: sd(g_t) / |mean(g_t)| over the last 10 annual growth rates (>= 4 needed); n/m if |mean| < 1%

name: PAT growth volatility
equation: sd(g_t) / |mean(g_t)| of core PAT growth over the last 10 years (base year PAT > 0); n/m if |mean| < 1%

name: Quarterly YoY growth trend
equation: OLS slope of the last 4 values of (Revenue_q / Revenue_q-4 - 1), per quarter

name: NII / average assets (NIM proxy)
equation: (Interest earned - Interest expended) / average total assets

name: Revenue / average assets
note: informational (neutral direction)

name: Cost of funds
note: no sourced band and fewer than 4 same-archetype peers: level not scored

name: Cost (incl. provisions) / income
note: no sourced band and fewer than 4 same-archetype peers: level not scored
equation: (Total opex incl. provisions + depreciation) / (NII + other income)

note: informational (neutral direction)

name: P/E
note: current = market cap / TTM from last 4 quarters PAT (reported quarterly PAT)
equation: Market cap / core PAT (current: TTM PAT when available)

name: P/E percentile vs own history
equation: (# historical FY-end P/E below current + 0.5 x # equal) / # historical values

name: P/B
note: informational (neutral direction)

name: P/B percentile vs own history
equation: (# historical FY-end P/B below current + 0.5 x # equal) / # historical values

name: P/B-implied growth
note: informational (neutral direction)
equation: g = (Ke x P/B - ROE) / (P/B - 1); n/m if |P/B - 1| < 0.05

name: P/B-implied - delivered growth
equation: implied_growth_pb - BVPS CAGR 5y (PAT CAGR 5y if n/m)

name: Justified P/B
equation: (ROE - g) / (Ke - g); ROE = 3y avg, g = min(ROE x (1 - 3y avg payout), terminal g)
